source.method: Total return, dividends reinvested, indexed to 100 on 1998-12-22 — the day both Select Sector SPDRs listed, and therefore the only base date this volume needs. Closes are split- and dividend-adjusted. The published series is one observation per ISO week (the week's last close, never an average); CAGR and max drawdown are computed on the underlying daily series. `weight` is the company's disclosed weight in its sector fund, null when it falls outside the disclosed top holdings. `ipoYear` is the year the shares first traded publicly, null where that could not be confirmed against a citable record.
source.constituents: Six S&P 500 Consumer Discretionary members and six S&P 500 Consumer Staples members, all publicly traded on the base date. The roster is drawn from today's sector-fund holdings and is therefore a list of survivors by construction — see the extinction card for the other half.
